title: nepeta amethystina subsp. mallophora
intro: Nepeta amethystina subsp. mallophora, commonly known as Lavender Catmint, is a subspecies of the Nepeta genus, a type of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress levels, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta amethystina subsp. mallophora include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils such as linalool and β-pinene. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its therapeutic actions, providing relief from symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and other stress-related disorders.
